graph: pad the KV dimension of the no-cache attention to 256 ( #30416 ) 
 The no-cache path builds a [n_tokens, n_tokens] mask and passes K and V 
unpadded, so FLASH_ATTN_EXT sees K->ne[1] == n_tokens. The CUDA kernels 
for head size 512 require a multiple of FATTN_KQ_STRIDE, so
news.aiSummary: The no-cache attention path previously passed unpadded K and V tensors, causing the FLASH_ATTN_EXT kernel to see a head size equal to the token count. This update pads the KV dimension to 256 to satisfy CUDA kernel requirements for head size 512, which necessitates a multiple of FATTN_KQ_STRIDE.

news.aiSummary: The TorchScript function aten::device.with_index has two bugs.
